api:
<WordCloud data={terms} word={|t: &Term| t.word} weight={|t: &Term| t.count} group={|t: &Term| t.topic} />
PropTypeDefault
wordFn(&T) -> &strrequired
weightFn(&T) -> f64required
groupFn(&T) -> &str: colour and legendwords cycle through the palette
max_wordsusize: the heaviest are kept120
font_range(f32, f32): smallest and largest font size(11., 52.)
legendLegendshown with a group

Font size grows with the square root of weight. Words are placed heaviest first along a spiral from the centre, stretched to the chart's shape, and skipped if they don't fit. Words are horizontal.

Zoom: hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and scroll, or pinch on a trackpad, to zoom about the pointer. Drag to pan once zoomed in, and double-click to reset.

examples.title: Rust topics
examples.description: Size grows with weight and colour shows the topic; hover a word.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn topics() {
    let data = use_signal(rust_terms());
    rsx! { <WordCloud data={data} word={|t: &Term| t.word} weight={|t: &Term| t.weight} group={|t: &Term| t.topic} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Repeated words
examples.code:
#[component]
fn many() {
    let words = [
        "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta", "epsilon", "zeta", "eta", "theta", "iota", "kappa",
        "lambda", "mu", "nu", "xi", "omicron", "pi", "rho", "sigma", "tau", "upsilon", "phi",
        "chi", "psi", "omega",
    ];
    let data = use_signal(
        (0..96u64)
            .map(|index| Term {
                word: words[(index % 24) as usize],
                weight: 1. + noise(index) * 99.,
                topic: ["A", "B", "C"][(index % 3) as usize],
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <WordCloud data={data} word={|t: &Term| t.word} weight={|t: &Term| t.weight} class="h-96" /> }
}
